definitions.explanation: A T-shaped wooden stand hung with silk panels, used in Heian-period aristocratic houses to divide a room and to shield noblewomen from view. It appears constantly in classical literature and in period drama sets.

examples.japanese: {几帳|きちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{陰|かげ}→陰：14593_kage⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{隠|かく}れる→隠れる：02035_kakureru⟧。
examples.english: She hides behind the standing screen.

RELATED WORDS:
The adjective ⟦{几帳面|きちょうめん}→几帳面：06868_kichoumen⟧ (methodical, meticulous) is said to derive from the precise decorative joinery of the {几帳}'s posts — a useful memory hook, since the two words look related but describe very different things.
